title: Resolve Vietnam-to-Canada high latency white screen: production Nginx Docker container and React ErrorBoundary
assumptions: Container frontend on VPS was running Vite dev server (npm run dev) loading unbundled .tsx modules across high-latency link. Replaced with multi-stage production Nginx image serving bundled/gzip-compressed static files on port 3000.
React ErrorBoundary added to catch runtime rendering errors and slow API failures, displaying user-friendly recovery UI instead of blank white screen.
api.ts configured with 20s timeout and clear error messaging for slow network.
Nginx config proxies /api/ to backend:8000 and /ws to backend:8000 for seamless single-origin requests on port 3000.
LiveGame.tsx WebSocket URL patched to support both relative and absolute API URLs.
